name: humanize
title_zh: 写稿前先扫一遍 41 种 AI 腔的校对员
tagline_zh: 起草、编辑、审稿时一键去 AI 味：不再有「显著提升」「值得注意的是」这类空话。还能整文件夹审计。
tagline_en: Draft, edit, review: strip out AI-slop like 'significantly' and 'it's worth noting.' Audit a whole docs folder to.
desc_en: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from prose, and keep it out of a repo. Use when drafting, editing, or reviewing text to make it sound natural and human, or when auditing a whole docs folder for AI slop. Detects 41 patterns across content, language, style, communication, filler, and rhetoric, including: significance inflation, promotional language, -ing tails, vague attributions, AI vocabulary
why_zh: 不是简单替换词，而是按内容、语言、风格、修辞等六类 41 种模式逐条检测。
why_en: Not a find-replace hack: it flags 41 patterns across six categories—content, language, style, rhetoric, filler, communication—so.
limit_zh: 只处理文本，不处理 Markdown 代码块或表格；对非英语文本无效；检测基于规则，可能漏掉语境相关的 AI 味。
limit_en: Text only; ignores code blocks/tables. Non-English text unsupported. Rule-based, so context-dependent AI tone may slip through. Manual review.
title_en: A proofreader that scans for 41 AI-writing patterns before.
